title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-05 21:50:17 最新章节：第1200章 深处的回应
lines: 冰风如刀，从北方永冻荒原刮来，凄厉地切割着索兰尼亚丘陵的岩石。
雪花像淬毒的碎玻璃，砸在卡拉斯残破的鳞甲上，噼啪作响。
他佝偻着背，每一步都深陷积雪，每一次拔腿都用尽全身力气。
狂风灌进头盔，冻结了他的喘息。
整个世界，仿佛只剩下这无尽的严寒，和他胸腔里那颗濒临枯竭的心脏。
一个鼓囊沉重的包裹，被他用破烂斗篷紧紧绑在胸前。
那是他仅存的一切，比生命更重。
每次跌倒，他都本能地用双臂死死护住它，任凭冰碴割破手腕。
“撑住…”
卡拉斯的声音被风撕碎。
这句话，更像是说给自己那具快要散架的躯壳。
他必须找到庇护所。
不是为了自己，是为了怀里那个沉甸甸的、维系着最后希望的火种。
记忆翻涌上来，比风雪更刺骨。
天空是永恒的铅灰色，阳光吝啬得只剩几缕惨白。
大地死寂，远处耸立着黑暗之后塔克西丝教会的“净化尖塔”
，如同插入大地的黑色獠牙，顶端燃烧着暗红火焰，日夜焚烧“异端”
金属龙骑士团…这个名字早已成为禁忌。
帕拉丁的神殿崩塌，神像被砸碎砌进了尖塔地基。
龙，那些翱翔天际的伟大生物，几乎被屠戮殆尽。
色彩龙族成了教会的爪牙，而金属龙——它们的巢穴被撕裂，龙蛋在火焰中化为灰烬。
卡拉斯是最后的骑士。
他不知道自己是怎样活下来的，只记得战友们用生命将他推出包围，将一个沉重、温热的龙蛋塞进他怀里。
“活下去…带它…走！”
这命令支撑着他，在追捕中像老鼠一样东躲西藏，在荒野里茹毛饮血。
风雪似乎小了些，寒意却更刺骨。
卡拉斯抬起头，看见前方一片巨大、倾斜的黑色阴影——风雷堡的废墟。
这座曾以龙骑士为荣的雄伟堡垒，如今只剩残垣断壁，如同巨兽的骸骨。
几段断裂的城墙指向天空，上面残留着焦黑的灼痕和巨大的爪印。
绝望如同毒蛇，缠绕上来。
他怎么跑到这里来了？这地方太显眼，简直是黑暗之后赐予的指路明灯！
他想逃离，双腿却沉重得无法挪动。
身后的风声里，夹杂了别的东西——金属甲片摩擦撞击的声音！
卡拉斯猛地回头。
几个黑影正以惊人速度逼近。
他们身穿黑色狰狞鳞甲，头盔如同兽首，眼缝里闪烁红光。
手中握着缠绕暗影能量的锯齿弯刀——塔克西丝教会最精锐的“暗鳞追猎者”
content_en:
The icy wind is like a knife, blowing from the permafrost wasteland in the north, cutting the rocks of the Solamnian hills fiercely.
The snowflakes were like quenched broken glass, hitting Karas' broken scales with a crackling sound.
He was hunched over, sinking deeply into the snow with every step he took, and using all his strength every time he lifted his legs.
The strong wind filled his helmet and froze his breathing.
The whole world seemed to be filled with only the endless cold and the dying heart in his chest.
A bulging and heavy package was tied tightly to his chest with a tattered cloak.
It was all he had left, heavier than life.
Every time he fell, he instinctively used his arms to protect it, allowing the ice to cut his wrists.
"Hold on..."
Karas's voice was torn by the wind.
This sentence is more like saying it to his body that is about to fall apart.
He must find shelter.
Not for myself, but for the heavy fire in my arms that holds the last hope.
Memories surged up, more piercing than the wind and snow.
The sky is an eternal leaden gray, and the sunlight is so stingy that only a few pale wisps remain.
The earth is deathly silent, and in the distance stands the "Purification Spire" of the Church of Takhisis, Queen of Darkness.
, like black fangs inserted into the earth, with dark red flames burning at the top, burning "heresies" day and night
Metal Dragon Knights... This name has long become taboo.
The Paladin's temple collapsed, and the statue was smashed into the foundation of the spire.
The dragons, those great creatures that soared across the sky, were almost wiped out.
The chromatic dragons became minions of the church, and the metal dragons—their lairs were torn apart, and their eggs were reduced to ashes in the flames.
Karas is the last knight.
He didn't know how he survived. He only remembered that his comrades used their lives to push him out of the surrounding area and stuffed a heavy, warm dragon egg into his arms.
"Stay alive...take it...away!"
This order supported him, hiding like a mouse in the pursuit, and drinking blood in the wilderness.
The wind and snow seemed to be lighter, but the chill was more biting.
Karas raised his head and saw a huge, sloping black shadow in front of him - the ruins of Wind Thunder Castle.
This majestic fortress that was once proud of its dragon knights now only remains in ruins, like the bones of a giant beast.
Several broken sections of the city wall point to the sky, with scorched burn marks and huge claw marks remaining on them.
Despair is like a poisonous snake, coiling around me.
Why did he get here? This place is so conspicuous, it is simply a guiding light given after darkness!
He wanted to escape, but his legs were too heavy to move.
The sound of the wind behind him was mixed with something else - the sound of metal armor scraping and hitting!
Karas turned around sharply.
Several dark figures were approaching at an alarming speed.
They were wearing ferocious black scale armor, their helmets were like animal heads, and their eyes were flashing with red light.
Holding in his hand a serrated scimitar entwined with shadow energy - the most elite "Dark Scale Stalker" of the Taksis Church
